block.BuffTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When buffed
editor.skill_help.block.buff_trigger.exa: Vanilla card 123 reacts when a Plant gains stats. Card 547 (High Diver) also uses this trigger as part of a complete recipe.
editor.skill_help.block.buff_trigger.lim: The marker alone does not filter for a positive buff or self. Vanilla card 123 also uses EffectValueCondition to require TotalBuffAmount ≥ 1. Strength and Health components, zero-value cases, and subsequent resolution require separate verification.
editor.skill_help.block.buff_trigger.pla: Ability group trigger component. Its native registration source is BuffEffect.
editor.skill_help.block.buff_trigger.usa: Used in recipes that trigger when stats increase or decrease.
block.category.Trigger.title: 🟢 Triggers
block.CombatEndTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Combat end
editor.skill_help.block.combat_end_trigg: Vanilla 165 Triple Cone in the original game eliminates adjacent zombies at the end of the turn; 199 King Zombie transforms other zombies at the end of the turn.

Different from LaneCombatEndTrigger for a single lane; 'end' does not mean it triggers after each unit attacks. The native phase boundary and the precise order of other end cleanups still need to be verified separately.
Skill group trigger component, native registration source is CombatPhaseEndEffect.
Used for original recipes related to the end of the turn.
block.DamageTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When damaged
editor.skill_help.block.damage_trigger.e: Vanilla card 53 draws a card after dealing damage. Card 83 (Hibernating Beary) gains Strength after taking damage.
editor.skill_help.block.damage_trigger.l: Source and target filters determine who deals damage and who takes it. The marker does not automatically select self. Trigger behavior for zero damage, protection, or canceled events still needs gameplay verification.
editor.skill_help.block.damage_trigger.p: Ability group trigger component. Its native registration source is DamageEffect.
editor.skill_help.block.damage_trigger.u: Used in recipes that trigger when damage is dealt or taken.
block.DestroyCardTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When destroying a card
editor.skill_help.block.destroy_card_tri: Vanilla card 491 (Supernova Gargantuar) clears matching Plants after a Gargantuar destroys a Plant. Card 514 (Final Mission) follows destruction with damage.

This is a different event from DiscardFromPlayTrigger. Preserve the original structure regardless of whether the card text says "destroyed." The complete recipe filters the source, destroyed entity, and follow-up chain. Failed actions and timing still need verification.
Ability group trigger component. Its native registration source is DestroyCardEffect.
Used in vanilla recipes that trigger on destroy actions.
block.DiscardFromPlayTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When destroyed / leaves play
editor.skill_help.block.discard_from_pla: Vanilla 1 Avocado is destroyed, dealing damage to the same lane zombie; 64 Come On creates a Food card under relevant destruction conditions.

This is not a general-purpose button for discarding cards from hand. It is registered separately from DestroyCardTrigger; returning to hand, transformation, and all ways of leaving play must not be treated as the same event. Preserve the original card's conditions regarding specific destruction causes and timing.
Skill group trigger component, natively registered source is DiscardFromPlayEffect.
Used for associated recipes after original destruction/exit.
block.DrawCardFromSubsetTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Draw from subset
editor.skill_help.block.draw_card_from_s: Vanilla 449 Cucumber Captain reduces the cost of cards created; 501 Wormhole Guardian reduces the cost of created cards for both players.

Corresponding to the create/conjure path, not equal to drawing cards from an existing deck or summoning to the field. The same effect also registers a DrawCardTrigger, so you cannot assume that two markers are mutually exclusive or that any combination will trigger only once.
Skill group trigger component, natively registered source is DrawCardFromSubsetEffect.
Used for trigger recipes related to creating hand cards from the card pool.
block.DrawCardTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When drawing
editor.skill_help.block.draw_card_trigge: Vanilla card 126 (Bananasaurus Rex) uses this for Dino-Roar. Card 551 gains Strength based on the cost of a card it Conjures.

This trigger is registered for DrawCardEffect, DrawCardFromSubsetEffect, and KeepSuperblockCardEffect, so it can react to more than ordinary draws. Vanilla cards also use it for Conjure follow-ups. Registration alone does not establish behavior for a full hand, canceled actions, zero amounts, or resolution order.
Ability group trigger component. The trigger source, target, and drawn card are distinct.
Used in vanilla recipes that trigger when a card is gained or drawn.
block.EnterBoardTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When entering the board
editor.skill_help.block.enter_board_trig: Vanilla 252 Confused Gravedigger and 595 Tombstone Demolisher use this marker for their complete ability group.

Native registers separately as PlayCardEffect, CreatedCardEffect, TransformedCardEffect; not mutually exclusive event partitions with Play, and does not promise equivalence for all summoning, resurrection, appearance, or evolution processes. Cannot freely swap or remove the original filter just because the names are similar.
Ability group trigger component, retains the original recipe's trigger target and state conditions.
Used for trigger markers related to the original card entering the field.
block.ExtraAttackTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Extra attack
editor.skill_help.block.extra_attack_tri: Original 117 Party Thyme draws cards when plants perform extra attacks; 620 Giant Corpse Jester follows non-jester units for extra attacks.

Extra attack and normal attack must be distinguished; it is not a 'extra attack count' parameter, nor does it automatically exclude itself or other jester-type objects. The original card's anti-recursive conditions and actual action timing continue to be retained.
Skill group trigger component, native registration source is ExtraAttackInLaneEffect.
Used for trigger recipes related to extra attacks.
block.HealTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When healing
editor.skill_help.block.heal_trigger.exa: Original version 153 Pepper Doctor adds attributes when plants or heroes receive healing; 471 Heart Thistle uses the healing amount in the damage formula.
editor.skill_help.block.heal_trigger.lim: Healing source, target, and final effect target are filtered separately; does not automatically restrict self or allied heroes. Full health, 0 healing, cancellation, and precise calculation of effect values still require separate verification.
editor.skill_help.block.heal_trigger.pla: Skill group trigger component, native registration source is HealEffect.
editor.skill_help.block.heal_trigger.usa: Used for triggering formulas related to healing.
block.LaneCombatEndTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Lane combat end
editor.skill_help.block.lane_combat_end_: Original 437 Flash Blueberry deals damage after the battle ends on its own lane; 562 Double Attack Ability Template also uses this marker.

Not equal to the entire combat phase or the end of the entire round; it depends on the original recipe to determine if it is on the unit's own lane. Empty lanes, additional attacks, and cleanup order are not guaranteed by this local description.
Skill group trigger component, native registration source is LaneCombatEndEffect.
Used for trigger recipes related to single lane combat end.
block.LaneCombatStartTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Lane combat start
editor.skill_help.block.lane_combat_star: Original 415 Spike Trap Area deals damage to zombies before the battle on its own lane; 431 Hot Lava deals damage to both sides on the lane before the battle.

Not triggered after damage occurs, and does not automatically mean it only affects the same lane. The lane object and the final affected unit are determined separately by filtering and target selector, and the order of effects like lane-specific and pre-battle effects still needs verification.
Skill group trigger component, native registration source is LaneCombatPreStartEffect.
Used for triggers before single-lane combat.
block.MoveTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When moved
editor.skill_help.block.move_trigger.exa: Original 65 Deep Sea Zombie handles related gains for zombie entering lane; 186 Wrist Wrestling Zombie reacts to the appearance of plants on this lane.
editor.skill_help.block.move_trigger.lim: The moved object, destination lane, and self are different roles; do not treat all card creation, card plays, or failed moves as the same event. Preserve the positions before and after movement and the other trigger groups from the original recipe.
editor.skill_help.block.move_trigger.pla: Skill group trigger component, native registration source is MoveCardToLanesEffect.
editor.skill_help.block.move_trigger.usa: Used for trigger recipes related to movement.
block.PlayTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When played
editor.skill_help.block.play_trigger.exa: Original 2 Chimney Worker Zombies in high ground add attributes; 3 Conga Dance Zombies tombstone appears to cause damage.
editor.skill_help.block.play_trigger.lim: Native for PlayCardEffect, CreatedCardEffect, TransformedCardEffect, and RevealEffect to register this mark, cannot be limited to a single hand card → battlefield action. Whether each path actually triggers is still subject to original card filtering and status constraints, cancellation and special timing are not guaranteed by registration relationships.
editor.skill_help.block.play_trigger.pla: Trigger component in the skill group, working with trigger target, source, and self status filtering.
editor.skill_help.block.play_trigger.usa: Trigger marker used for recipes related to original casting/creation/transforming/appearance.
block.ReturnToHandTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When returned to hand
editor.skill_help.block.return_to_hand_t: Vanilla 607 Jell-O Bean gains +1/+1 when the card is returned to hand.

Not drawing from the deck, creating copies, or moving from any zone; whether requiring a faction or self still being filtered is determined. Return to hand failures, transition states, and all boundaries of order are yet to be verified.
Skill group trigger component, native registration source is ReturnToHandFromPlayEffect.
Used for trigger recipes related to cards returning to hand.
block.RevealPhaseEndTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Reveal phase end
editor.skill_help.block.reveal_phase_end: The brain gain group of the original 317 Gentleman Zombie uses this marker, originally described as Zombie Trick card at the start of the turn.

It is not a RevealTrigger when each tombstone appears, and it is separately registered from SurprisePhaseStartTrigger; it cannot be freely swapped between the two merely because the original Chinese mentions the trick turn.
Skill group trigger component, native registration source is RevealPhaseEndEffect.
Used for trigger recipes related to the end of the reveal phase.
block.RevealTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When revealed
editor.skill_help.block.reveal_trigger.e: Original 323 Tombstone Sculptor adds attributes to revealed zombies; 539 Cemetery adds attack to zombies appearing on this lane.
editor.skill_help.block.reveal_trigger.l: The same RevealEffect also registers PlayTrigger; this does not mean both must be added simultaneously, nor does it guarantee that any combination will trigger only once. The revealed object, same lane, and faction conditions must be configured separately, and the end of the phase as a whole uses another marker.
editor.skill_help.block.reveal_trigger.p: Skill group trigger component, native registration source is RevealEffect.
editor.skill_help.block.reveal_trigger.u: Used for trigger recipes related to tombstone reveal/reveal.
block.SlowedTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: When frozen (Slow)
editor.skill_help.block.slowed_trigger.e: Original 131 Snowflake adds attributes when zombies are frozen; 134 Winter Pumpkin handles frozen zombies or tombstones.
editor.skill_help.block.slowed_trigger.l: The name is not the concept of normal movement speed; it does not automatically limit zombies, survival, or selectable targets. Repeated freezing, skipping attacks, and cleanup timing still require state consumers and actual effect verification.
editor.skill_help.block.slowed_trigger.p: Skill Group trigger component, native registration source is SlowEffect.
editor.skill_help.block.slowed_trigger.u: Used for trigger recipes related to the original frozen event.
block.SurprisePhaseStartTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Surprise phase start
editor.skill_help.block.surprise_phase_s: The original 494 Sun Vampire zombie gains attributes and moves during the trick phase; 535 Gene Experiment gains attributes after checking adjacent lane zombies.

Marking does not automatically select a faction or itself; original cards still have their own states, same lane or adjacent lane conditions; it is understood separately from the start of the turn and the end of the reveal phase; the exact order of phases still needs verification.
Skill group trigger component; the original registration source is SurprisePhaseStartEffect.
Used for the original trick card phase start related trigger recipe.
block.TurnStartTrigger.title: 🟢 Trigger: Turn start
editor.skill_help.block.turn_start_trigg: The original 107 Small Seed transforms at the start of the turn; 116 Pea Pod gains +1/+1 at the start of the turn.

The marker itself does not automatically restrict to 'only self' or a certain faction, nor does it replace the original recipe's survival or activity conditions; it is registered separately from the beginning of the trick phase and the end of the reveal, with specific order still needing verification.
Trigger component in the skill group, originally registered from TurnStartEffect.
Trigger marker used for recipes at the start of the turn.
